title: 0294: RADZIWILL LIMITATION + WALL SHARPENED - the M2 gap object is now the SHARP residual asymptotic 1/theta (named levSharp, machine-bridged by residSharp); the universal limitation is ℐ ≥ c/theta for ALL theta (unconditional, ineffective c) and is NOT the gap; published reach of the sharp version: 0 < theta < 1/2

keyStatements: THE SETUP: the residual I(M) = inf_{T>=T0} (1/T) int_T^{2T} |1 - M_T(1/2+it) zeta(1/2+it) - R_T|^2 dt, T0 'sufficiently large' depending on the mollifier class M.

THEOREM 1 (UNCONDITIONAL, PUBLISHED): for theta > 0 and an admissible coefficient set M (in particular M_T = sum_{n<=T^theta} a_n n^{-it}), int_T^{2T} |1 - M_T(1/2+it) zeta(1/2+it)|^2 dt >= (c/theta) T, c > 0 INEFFECTIVE.

THE PROOF SPLIT: the lower bound goes through Proposition A (a SOBOLEV-INEQUALITY-ON-THE-ZEROS argument, valid for ALL theta) AND, for theta <= 1/2, Proposition B (the B-C-H-B / Soundararajan explicit off-diagonal quadratic form - cited as 'the method of [15], see Proposition B of [15]'), which is where the sharp bound lives.

SHARP REACH: the ASYMPTOTIC residual ~ (1/theta)T (i.e. constant 1, the top of the universal bound) is PUBLISHED ONLY for 0 < theta < 1/2 (the (1.2) moment asymptotic I_theta(T) ~ T/theta + O(T) is a corollary of it; Conrey carried (1.2) to 4/7 for the moment, but the sharp residual machinery is the theta < 1/2 one). For theta > 1/2 only the unconditional c/theta lower bound (Prop A) remains - the explicit off-diagonal form is the barrier.

sharpening: 0293 named [LEV-WALL] = the pointwise (1.2) asymptotic (published 0 < theta < 4/7). 0294 pins the MECHANISM from the primary source and narrows the obstacle: (a) the UNIVERSAL limitation (no mollifier kills the residual better than c/theta, all theta) is UNCONDITIONAL and does not restrict the theta-frontier to 1/2 - a positive lower bound alone cannot be the frontier obstruction; (b) what M2's lane actually needs past the published frontier is the SHARP asymptotic - residual/T -> exactly 1/theta - and its published reach is 0 < theta < 1/2, because the sharp constant comes from the B-C-H-B explicit OFF-DIAGONAL quadratic form (Soundararajan Prop B) which breaks down for theta > 1/2. The named obstruction to extending M2 is therefore levSharp(theta) at theta > 1/2, i.e. exactly: new off-diagonal control of int |sum_{m,n<=T^theta, m ne n} ...|^2 at longer sums.
